answer: Relying on a comforting fable of zero cost network access invites catastrophic thermal excursions. Smooth velvet flow paths fail instantly when a sudden primary coolant pump trips and drops core heat removal margins to zero. Surrounding the volatile agent core in a wide, high heat capacity meadow of cryptoeconomic stake burns out attackers economically because fabricating millions of fake identities demands massive capital lockup. The attack limit sits at the threshold where sustained collateral slashing costs exceed any possible payout from disrupting consensus.
